tbesh_html:
§ Chinneroth or Cinneroth or Chinnereth = "harps"
a town and district in Naphtali near the Sea of Galilee

strongs_1890.strongs_def: Kinneroth or Kinnereth, a place in Palestine
strongs_1890.derivation: or כִּנֶּרֶתlemma כִּנֶרֶת missing dagesh, corrected to כִּנֶּרֶת; respectively plural and singular feminine from the same as H3658 (כִּנּוֹר); perhaps harp-shaped;
